text:
kira: Quick heads-up — brief all-hands tomorrow (Mar 24) at 09:30 PT. It'll be focused: product 'Scanlight' demo, a couple of policy callouts, and a short blip postmortem from last week's deploy. Please drop any questions in this thread by EOD so we can prioritize. Agenda below 👇

kira: ```Agenda (30m total)
1) 09:30 - 09:40: Scanlight demo + launch readiness (Product)
2) 09:40 - 09:45: Dedicated region callout (ops)
3) 09:45 - 09:50: Policy updates (security key rotation + PTO accrual tweak)
4) 09:50 - 09:55: Deploy blip postmortem (what went wrong, current mitigations)
5) 09:55 - 10:00: Live Q&A / wrap-up (10m)
```

matt: Can we squeeze a 2–3 minute note on the new dedicated GPU region launch? A lot of infra teams have customers waiting. :rocket:

kira: Yes — added a 3-min slot after the demo. matt, can you do the short callout?

matt: Yep. I'll have one slide and the rollout ETA.

elaine: What's the policy update about? PTO or security?
junaid: +1 — want to know if this affects on-call rotations.

kira: Two separate items:
- Security: we're moving to mandatory key rotation every 90 days for service accounts (details in the policy doc we'll link during the all-hands).
- People policy: small change to PTO accrual cliff for new hires joining mid-quarter (aimed at fairness for later start dates). Neither affects on-call scheduling this quarter.

lia: I've got a question about rollout canaries for Scanlight — will we keep the current canary window or expand? Can I drop it here as Q: rollout canary window?
kira: Yes please — put Q: at the start so we can filter and prioritize.

matt: Q: Any latency SLAs changing with the dedicated region launch?
kira: Short answer: no SLA change; it's capacity and geo proximity to reduce p99 for APAC customers. We'll discuss details in the callout.

elaine: Q: For the key rotation, is there a recommended migration path for long-lived service accounts?
kira: Q: recommended migration path — yes, we'll publish a small migration guide and a script. Ops will offer a 2-week grace window for teams to test.

lia: :raised_hands: also have a visibility question on how deploy blip delays are surfaced in Console metrics.
junaid: Adding: can we get the incident timeline in the notes?
kira: We'll include an abbreviated timeline in the postmortem slide; full timeline + logs will be in the incident doc after the all-hands.

ops-bot: Reminder: recording and deck link will be posted here after the meeting.

(After meeting)

ops-bot: Recording uploaded: https://redwood.in/recordings/1768000000-scanlight. Deck: https://redwood.in/decks/scanlight-launch-1768000000.pdf :white_check_mark:

kira: Thanks everyone who joined. Key takeaways posted below — if you asked a Q and didn't see it answered, flag it here or ping me.

kira: ```Takeaways:
- Scanlight is green to roll; region deploy will begin next week with staged canaries.
- No SLA changes; APAC p99 expected to improve by ~20ms with new region.
- Security: mandatory 90-day key rotation for service accounts; migration guide + script will be published by EOD Friday.
- People: PTO accrual cliff adjustment for mid-quarter hires effective next payroll cycle.
- Postmortem: root cause was an autoscaler misconfig for a new config path; mitigation=rollback + tighter preflight check.
- Action owners assigned below.
```

kira: Action items: 1) matt -> share launch checklist and customer comms doc (due Tue) 2) ops -> publish migration script & run a test rotation for platform services (due Fri) 3) eng-sre -> add preflight check to deploy pipeline and run a smoke test (due Wed)

matt: I've uploaded the launch checklist to the shared folder and added a PR for the customer comms draft: https://redwood.in/links/scanlight-comm-pr

junaid: Noted — will schedule the smoke test Wed morning and post results here.

elaine: Thanks, good meeting. Recording looks clear. :clap:

kira: Closing thread — thanks for the questions. If anything urgent pops up, DM me or drop into #eng-oncall.
